cases.requirement: Enumerate the complete immutable Git tag registry and reject a missing, duplicate, or malformed plan authority.
Accept the current release-plan v2 authority, retain only the exact digest-allowlisted historical v1 plans, and reject unrecorded v1 or unsupported schema values.
Select the unique completed current plan for verification-only recovery while refusing any attempt to republish it whether selected explicitly or implicitly.
Resolve a superseded plan only through its digest-bound successor and select the surviving product train.
Reject a successor edge whose tag, plan document, or canonical plan digest is not an exact identity match.
Reject malformed and type-coercible authority values before plan selection, including non-exact SemVer.

Accept one exactly qualified immutable digest-bound resolution selecting a member of the exact continuity claim set independent of enumeration order only when discovery, record, and qualification lookups use their declared authority identities, and reject every unresolved or invalid fork.
Allow an explicitly requested completed plan to verify as a no-op, and reject a superseded plan before publication or distribution verification.
Re-enumerate lifecycle authority and fail closed when the registry does not converge within the declared attempt bound.
